text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Spanish King Juan Carlos meets visiting Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says in circular to governors over local council elections that "order and public safety must be ensured."
- Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar and Moroccan counterpart Abdellatif Filali describe meetings as fruitful."
- There are only 30 cars for every 1,000 people in Morocco.
- Moroccan and French businessmen meeting in Casablanca assesses relations with the European Union and debt conversion.
- Morocco to float 20 percent of Imiter silver mine mid-June.
- Moroccan firms start realizing need to meet environment protection regulations as ecology becomes part of the marketing policy.
